title: API authentication failing after update
description: Customer reports 401 errors when making API calls after recent platform update. Using correct credentials but getting authentication failures.
resolution_notes: Updated API documentation and provided new authentication method. Customer implemented successfully.

title: Cannot understand billing calculation
description: Customer confused about usage-based billing charges on latest invoice. Multiple line items unclear.
resolution_notes: Explained billing structure and provided detailed breakdown. Need better billing documentation.

title: Need export functionality for reports
description: Customer wants to export dashboard reports to PDF format. Current system only allows CSV export.
resolution_notes: Showed workaround using print-to-PDF. Added feature request to product backlog.

title: Bulk data import failing with large files
description: Enterprise customer cannot import CSV files larger than 50MB. Process times out or fails completely.
resolution_notes: Increased timeout limits and provided chunking strategy. Need better documentation on data limits.

title: Cannot add new team members
description: Admin user unable to invite new team members. Invite button not working as expected.
resolution_notes: Fixed permission issue and resent invites. Updated user management guide.

title: Credit card payment keeps failing
description: Customer's valid credit card being declined repeatedly. No issues with card from their bank.
resolution_notes: Updated payment processor settings and processed payment manually. Payment system needs improvement.

title: Dashboard loading very slowly
description: Enterprise dashboard takes 2-3 minutes to load with large datasets. Performance is impacting daily workflow.
resolution_notes: Optimized queries and added caching. Recommended data archiving strategy.

title: Webhook not receiving all events
description: Customer's webhook endpoint missing some event notifications. Integration appears incomplete.
resolution_notes: Fixed webhook configuration and resent missed events. Need better webhook documentation.

title: Mobile app not syncing with web version
description: Changes made in mobile app not appearing in web dashboard. Data sync issue.
resolution_notes: Forced sync and resolved caching issue. Mobile sync working correctly now.

title: Single Sign-On configuration not working
description: Enterprise customer cannot get SAML SSO working with their identity provider. Multiple configuration attempts failed.
resolution_notes: Worked with customer's IT team to configure SAML properly. Need better SSO setup guide.

title: Want to upgrade plan but button not working
description: Customer trying to upgrade from Standard to Premium but upgrade process failing at payment step.
resolution_notes: Processed upgrade manually and fixed payment flow issue. Upgrade process working normally now.

title: Reports showing incorrect data
description: Customer reports that analytics dashboard showing wrong numbers compared to their internal tracking.
resolution_notes: Identified data mapping issue and corrected calculations. Need clearer documentation on metrics definitions.

title: System timeout during peak hours
description: Enterprise customer experiencing frequent timeouts during business hours affecting productivity.
resolution_notes: Increased server capacity and optimized peak hour performance. Monitoring system performance.

title: Need to export all historical data
description: Customer wants to export 2 years of historical data for compliance audit. Current export limited to 6 months.
resolution_notes: Created custom export script for historical data. Need self-service option for large exports.

title: Email notifications not being received
description: Customer not receiving automated email notifications from the system. All other functions working.
resolution_notes: Fixed email configuration and verified delivery. Email notifications working correctly now.

title: GDPR compliance questions and data deletion
description: Enterprise customer needs to understand GDPR compliance features and delete specific user data per request.
resolution_notes: Explained GDPR features and processed data deletion request. Need comprehensive privacy documentation.

title: Database connection errors intermittently
description: Customer experiencing intermittent database connection failures affecting application stability.
resolution_notes: Identified and fixed connection pooling issue. Database connections stable now.

title: Request refund for unused subscription time
description: Customer needs refund for remaining time on annual subscription due to business closure.
resolution_notes: Processed pro-rated refund according to policy. Refund completed successfully.

title: Custom fields not saving data correctly
description: Enterprise customer's custom fields losing data after form submission. Critical business impact.
resolution_notes: Fixed data validation issue causing field data loss. Custom fields working correctly now.

title: Cannot reset password - email not arriving
description: Customer unable to reset password as reset emails not being delivered to their inbox.
resolution_notes: Fixed email delivery issue and resent password reset. Customer able to access account.

title: Application not working in Safari browser
description: Customer cannot use application in Safari browser. Features not loading correctly.
resolution_notes: Identified Safari-specific JavaScript issue and deployed fix. Application working in all browsers now.

title: Automated workflows not triggering correctly
description: Enterprise automation rules not executing as configured. Business processes being disrupted.
resolution_notes: Fixed workflow engine bug and restarted affected automations. Workflows executing correctly now.

title: Tax calculations appear incorrect on invoice
description: Customer questioning tax calculations on latest invoice. Amounts don't match their expectations.
resolution_notes: Reviewed tax settings and corrected regional tax configuration. Invoice taxes calculating correctly now.

title: Search feature not returning expected results
description: Customer unable to find records using search function. Results incomplete or missing.
resolution_notes: Updated search indexing and improved search algorithm. Search returning accurate results now.

title: API rate limiting blocking legitimate usage
description: Enterprise customer hitting API rate limits during normal business operations. Blocking critical integrations.
resolution_notes: Increased rate limits for enterprise tier and optimized API usage patterns.

title: Team member permissions not working as expected
description: Customer unable to set proper permissions for different team roles. Access controls not functioning.
resolution_notes: Fixed permission system bug and updated team member roles. Permissions working correctly now.

title: File upload feature completely broken
description: Customer cannot upload any files to the system. Upload process fails immediately.
resolution_notes: Fixed file storage configuration and restored upload functionality. File uploads working normally now.

title: Advanced analytics module showing no data
description: Enterprise customer's advanced analytics dashboard completely empty despite having data.
resolution_notes: Rebuilt analytics data pipeline and restored historical analytics data.

title: Issues with automatic contract renewal
description: Customer's contract renewed with incorrect terms and pricing. Billing discrepancies need resolution.
resolution_notes: Corrected contract terms and adjusted billing to match agreed pricing.

title: Questions about data backup and recovery
description: Customer wants to understand data backup procedures and how to recover deleted information.
resolution_notes: Explained backup policy and restored accidentally deleted data for customer.
